title: Prism Axis
description: Axis configuration for a position channel.

axis.description: Axis options including title, ticks, grid, and label placement. Null suppresses the axis entirely (no domain line, ticks, labels, title or grid) and releases the padding its side reserved — omitting the `axis` key instead keeps the default axis.

orient.description: Side of the plot the axis occupies, and the side its padding is reserved on. Only two of the four are meaningful per channel — `bottom` (default) or `top` on x, `left` (default) or `right` on y; the other two are rejected as PRISM_SPEC_044.

title.description: Axis title. A string replaces the derived title; false suppresses it. The title block is separate from `"axis": null`, which suppresses the whole axis.

tick_count.description: How many major ticks to aim for on a continuous axis (linear, log, pow, sqrt, time). A hint, not a guarantee: the generator rounds to a readable step and may land either side of the request. Omit for the default of 5; 0 removes every tick. Grid lines sit at the major tick positions, so this also controls how many grid lines appear. Ignored on discrete (band / point / ordinal) axes, which tick once per category.

tick_min_step.description: Smallest gap, in domain units, allowed between adjacent generated ticks. Enforced by asking the generator for fewer ticks so the survivors stay round. Shapes generated ticks only - `values` pins exactly what it names.

tick_size.description: Tick mark length in pixels. Overrides the theme's --prism-axis-tick-size token; minor ticks stay proportionally shorter.

values.description: Explicit tick set, replacing the generated one and overriding `tick_count` and `tick_min_step`. Numbers on a quantitative axis, ISO-8601 date strings (or epoch milliseconds) on a temporal axis, exact category names on a discrete one. Entries outside the resolved scale domain are dropped with PRISM_WARN_AXIS_VALUES_DROPPED rather than drawn off-plot. Grid lines follow the pinned set; minor ticks are suppressed.

labels.description: Whether to draw tick labels. False suppresses only the labels — the tick marks, domain line, grid and title stay — and releases the padding they reserved.

label_angle.description: Rotation angle in degrees for tick labels.

label_padding.description: Gap between the axis line and its tick labels in pixels. Overrides the theme's --prism-axis-label-padding token.

label_limit.description: Maximum allowed label width in pixels before the label is truncated with an ellipsis. 0 means no limit.

title_padding.description: Gap in pixels between the axis's tick labels and its title. Overrides the theme's --prism-axis-title-padding token (and the per-axis axis_x / axis_y block that layers over it); with all of them unset the built-in 8 px applies.

domain.description: Whether to draw the axis domain line. False suppresses only that line; it sits on the plot edge and reserves no padding.

ticks.description: Whether to draw tick marks. False suppresses only the marks — the labels derived from the same tick positions stay — and releases the padding they reserved.

zindex.description: Stacking order relative to the marks: 0 (the default) draws the axis and its grid lines behind them, any positive value draws them in front.
